title: Dây đàn trong mơ
about: Round x9, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("tôi muốn những bài âm thanh u tối nhưng dễ nghe để ngủ hơn, có thể thêm những giai điệu ngẫu hứng"): low strings soft and close, a single string improvising a slow song over them, long notes, long rests. E minor. Softer harmony than before (added ninths, major sevenths, no Phrygian rub), nothing sudden. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
